en.headline: Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force with extreme fire risk
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the warning, issued at 6.10am on Monday, continues as relative humidity stays low and conditions remain dry.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Red Fire Danger Warning remained in force on Tuesday evening, indicating extreme fire risk.
The warning was issued at 6.10am on Monday and has continued as the northeast monsoon brings dry air. At 9pm the Observatory recorded a temperature of 20 degrees and relative humidity of 38 per cent.
The Strong Monsoon Signal was cancelled at 11.45am on Tuesday, but the fire danger warning stays in place. The Observatory has reminded the public of the high fire risk under the dry conditions.
No other weather warnings were in force. The Observatory continues to monitor the situation.

zh.headline: 紅色火災危險警告仍然生效 火災危險性極高
zh.dek: 天文台指警告自周一上午六時十分發出後持續，相對濕度偏低，天氣乾燥。
body: 香港天文台表示，紅色火災危險警告周二晚上仍然生效，表示火災危險性極高。
警告於周一上午六時十分發出，隨着東北季候風帶來乾燥空氣而持續。晚上九時天文台錄得氣溫20度，相對濕度百分之38。
強烈季候風信號已於周二上午十一時四十五分取消，但火災危險警告維持。天文台提醒市民在乾燥天氣下火災危險性高。
目前沒有其他天氣警告生效。天文台繼續監察情況。
